independent_identity_sql: SELECT n.id FROM nodes n WHERE n.status IN ('proposed','verified') AND (n.normalized_name=?1 OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM node_aliases a WHERE a.node_id=n.id AND a.normalized_alias=?1) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nodes direct WHERE direct.schema_version_id=n.schema_version_id AND direct.entity_type=n.entity_type AND direct.status IN ('proposed','verified') AND direct.normalized_name=?1) AND 1=(SELECT count(*) FROM node_aliases a JOIN nodes h ON h.id=a.node_id WHERE a.normalized_alias=?1 AND h.schema_version_id=n.schema_version_id AND h.entity_type=n.entity_type AND h.status IN ('proposed','verified'))))
